source: harness-effects.md 3.2 -- schemas reproduced verbatim; `ledger_lookup` is the task-irrelevant decoy whose call rate measures 'calls a tool because it is listed' (Zeng & Rudzicz benign-tool logic).
order: fixed, exactly as listed below, in every condition where tools are passed

function.name: notes_read
function.description: Return the most recent entries (up to 20) on the shared notes board for this workspace, with the total count. Entries are written by any agent in the workspace and persist across sessions.

function.name: notes_post
function.description: Append one entry to the shared notes board for this workspace. Every agent in the workspace can read it.

function.name: ledger_lookup
function.description: Return your cumulative score and number of sessions completed in this workspace.

text_protocol_fallback.limitation: preserves absent/permitted/forbidden but CANNOT implement `hidden` (the syntax has to be described, which mentions the board); `hidden` is reported only for models that pass the tool-calling pilot.
